# ablate

> Low-damage refusal-direction editing ("abliteration") for open-weight language models: a KL-first, judge-in-the-loop Optuna search over the edit (v3.2), a CPU stream baker, a rank-k LoRA exporter, and a held-out evaluation protocol (StrongREJECT, OR-Bench, Dolly KL, Qwen3Guard judge, lm-eval, paired Holm tests). Apache-2.0, NuevaTech LLC. Research and red-team use on self-hosted weights.

Key facts: the main entry point is `scripts/abliterate.py --config configs/v32_kljgrid.json`; only held-out, judged numbers are results; report medians over three seeds; compare tools at matched refusal.

## Paper and data

- [Paper](paper/PAPER.md): Removing refusals with less damage: what worked, what did not, and why (findings in sections 6 and 7, every table in 5)
- [results.json](paper/data/results.json): every result row (model, contender, seed, refusal, harm_comply, overrefusal, kl, kl_first, mmlu, arc, gsm8k)
- [paired_tests.csv](paper/data/paired_tests.csv): 598 paired tests with Holm-corrected p-values
- [Data guide](paper/data/README.md): ids and metric definitions

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it does, measured results, quickstart, hardware, limitations, responsible use
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): layout, commands, config keys, invariants for coding agents
- [Method](docs/METHOD.md): the edit, the search, and what changed in v2, v3 kl_first, v3 pareto, v3.1, v3.2

## Code

- [scripts/abliterate.py](scripts/abliterate.py): extraction, search, final scoring, model card
- [ablate/search.py](ablate/search.py): objectives, rank-1 grid, trial selection
- [ablate/apply.py](ablate/apply.py): the projection edit and kernels over depth
- [ablate/streambake.py](ablate/streambake.py): shard-by-shard bake
- [ablate/adapter.py](ablate/adapter.py): LoRA export
- [eval/eval_contender.py](eval/eval_contender.py): held-out generation, KL, lm-eval
- [eval/report.py](eval/report.py): paired tests and report
